description: Figure 4.1 presents a series of line plots illustrating the Word Error Rate (WER) during the fine-tuning of the Whisper model across different configurations, categorized by the amount of trainable weights. The figure is composed of four distinct subplots, each corresponding to a different "type" of fine-tuning: "base", "small", "medium", and "large". All subplots share a common x-axis labeled "epoch", which ranges from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks, and a y-axis labeled "WER", which represents the word error rate. The "base" type plot (top right) shows four lines in blue, representing "base AdaLoRA_int4", "base AdaLoRA_int8", "base int4", and "base int8", all of which exhibit a general downward trend in WER from approximately 60 to 40 over the 6 epochs. The "small" type plot (bottom left) features four lines in orange, showing a peak in WER around epoch 2 before declining. The "medium" type plot (top right, second from top) displays four lines in green, with WER values starting around 30 and decreasing to below 20. The "large" type plot (bottom center) shows four lines in purple, with WER values starting around 25 and decreasing to below 15. The legend in each subplot identifies the specific model and configuration being plotted.
